sehemu: Part III: The Prime Minister, the Cabinet and the Government
maudhui: (1) There shall be a Cabinet whose members shall be the Vice-President, the Prime Minister, the President of Zanzibar and all the Ministers. (2) The President shall attend meetings of the Cabinet and shall preside over those meetings. Where the President is absent, the meetings shall be presided over by the Vice-President, and where both the President and the Vice-President are absent, the Prime Minister shall preside over the meetings. (3) Without prejudice to the provisions of Article 37(1) of this Constitution, the Cabinet shall be the principal organ for advising the President on all matters concerning the exercise of his powers. (4) The Attorney-General shall attend all meetings of the Cabinet and shall have all the rights of a member at those meetings except the right to vote. (5) The question whether any advice, and if so what advice, was given by the Cabinet to the President shall not be inquired into in any court.
